blocks.html: This was a 2-week Game Jam where my team and I worked to create a game based on the theme of “connections”. My primary role was Level Design and Environmental Art. I created both worlds and created the entire menu scene. I also aided in programming the puzzle mechanics for the game and individually created some puzzles with them as well.

items: Created scenery for 2 worlds and The Main Menu Scene
Main Menu Scene integrates UI and the 3D world into 1 space
Created multiple puzzles that are integrated in the world
Created multiple 3D assets and 2D UI tools to make the interface come alive
